## Purpose

A workflow-history sidebar (branded header, "New Project" CTA, search, date-grouped recent-run
list, logout) and its row component for a chat-session variant.

**`imported_by` is empty — neither component is currently mounted anywhere in the app.**
`DashboardLayout` uses `AppHeader`'s top nav instead of a left sidebar for run history and
navigation.

## Shape

- [Sidebar.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/sidebar/Sidebar.tsx) — takes `recentRuns` and groups them by date (Today/Yesterday/This Week/Earlier)
  via a local `groupByDate` helper. Each row maps `WorkflowType`/`WorkflowStatus` to an icon and
  color through static `TYPE_CONFIG`/`STATUS_ICON`/`STATUS_COLOR` lookup tables, and cleans
  `===`-marker-polluted titles via `parseRunInput`.
- [ChatSessionItem.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/sidebar/ChatSessionItem.tsx) — a single chat-session row with a hover-revealed delete button that
  requires a second confirming click within 2 seconds.

## Why this shape

Both components are standalone, self-contained list rows with no shared state. They were built
for a sidebar-first navigation layout that the app no longer uses — **`AppHeader` plus
`DashboardLayout`'s `mainView` switch replaced it**, which is why nothing currently imports
them.
